subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella remain the canonical tracker until Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention lands, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining issue now that the recovery carriers landed?
rationale: The remaining fix changes Anthropic thinking replay policy and has multiple open candidate PRs, so automation should not choose the permanent provider replay contract.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 after posting a clear handoff to the narrower prevention work.

options.title: Recovery Only For Now
options.body: Treat the merged recovery carrier fixes as sufficient for the release train and defer prevention to a later provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until a prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already in the issue discussion for the landed recovery half and has nearby provider/thinking history, making him the best available routing owner from this review.
